a1.text: You return. I watched how you fought. This time I know your rhythm.

a2.text: Again? The wind remembers every step you took.

a3.text: Every time you fall, I learn you better.

f3-2.text: It is finished. Rest now, Kiri.

m1-1.text: The girl from Kiri. I remember the night your village burned.

m1-2.text: Then remember this, Masatora. I have come for all three of you.

m1-3.text: Show me your blade. I will learn every cut of it.

m2-1.text: Masatora fell to you? Then the wind has carried your name up to these roofs.

m2-2.text: Your spear burned our fields, Kazemaru. Tonight it breaks, up here, with no one to hear.

m2-3.text: A sword cannot reach where my spear begins. Come, little ghost.

m3-1.text: So. The last ember of Kiri comes to die under my cherry trees.

m3-2.text: Kurogane. You gave the order. You held the torch.

m3-3.text: I have given a thousand orders, and I remember everyone who knelt. Kneel.

pro-1.text: Twelve winters ago, three generals rode into the mountain village of Kiri.

pro-2.text: By dawn it was ash. They wrote down the name of every warrior who stood against them.

pro-3.text: They call themselves the Order of the Remembering Blade. They never forget a fighter. They study you, and they learn.

pro-4.text: One child lived. Kaede took up her father's sword, and she has come for them.

pro-5.text: Three gates. Three generals. And each one will remember how you fight.

t1.text: I will remember how you fell.

t3.text: Rise again, girl. I will learn you again.
